They are general theorems for the pinned 36-glyph model, not vacuous; the compiled file reports propext and Quot.sound for several of them although its docstring says "stays within propext" (a minor docstring overclaim; this node re-proves them for every alphabet with propext only). The external prompt file named in the collection (prompts/fable_theorems_2026-10-17/05_sn_off_image_refusal.md) is not present in the checked-out source repository and was not read. The Rust witness verify_sn_off_image_refusal_witness is a fixed toy (section 2x, retraction y / 2 on {0..5}) that defines off-image as failure of the round trip; it does not exercise the S(n) syntax, so it gives refusal by definition. This node proves the non-circular statement (refusal iff no section image, using the soundness of the specific retraction), shows that the old-image law alone does not give refusal, and executes the pinned functions on explicit universes.

claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked, for every glyph alphabet and every stage: in the transcription of the pinned SnCarrier definitions (glyph alphabet abstracted, one-field wrappers flattened; restated, not imported) every accepted outcome of r_n is a section image with the base presentation as payload (accepted_only_from_section, accepted_iff), r_n refuses exactly the presentations that are no section image at that stage (nonDescent_iff_off_image), a section image at another stage is refused (retraction_stage_strict), sectionLift is injective (sectionLift_injective), and the image test is decided by the outcome (inImage_iff); the restated pair (sectionLift n, retrB n), with the outcome read as Base + Unit, is a SectionRetraction of the abstract part (sn_is_section_retraction), so refusal is exactly the absence of a base presentation lifting to p (sn_refused_iff_off_image); in the abstract setting of a section s and a retraction r with the old-image law and soundness, r refuses exactly off the image of s, the round trip s(r y) = y fails exactly off the image (refused_iff_off_image, roundtrip_fails_off_image), and the soundness hypothesis cannot be dropped (abstract instance on Fin 1 -> Fin 2; for S(n), laxRetr obeys the law and never refuses for every alphabet, and lax_breaks_refusal_characterisation is an instance on Bool glyphs at stage 0). refuseOffImage constructs a sound refusing retraction by testing the round trip (refuseOffImage_isSectionRetraction, toy_refused_iff_odd), so refusal-iff-off-image is circular by construction there and is not evidence for the S(n) statement. All S(n) re-proofs report propext only. Native: on eight explicit universes of presentations (up to 866 elements) the pinned lift and retraction are executed: refusal equals off-image with zero violations, payloads are correct, the round trip holds on exactly the image and fails on exactly the refused points, other-stage lifts and over-long bodies are refused, and the lax retraction recovers every base presentation (lax_law_holds) while refusing nothing (lax_refused = 0; both columns are by-construction consequences, the Lean file carries the statement); plus five toy sections x -> c x with exact on-image and refused counts.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: The claim that this closes the domain-restriction half of ledger row WDP-P001-019 (a ledger interpretation, not examined); the external prompt file fable_theorems_2026-10-17/05_sn_off_image_refusal.md named in the DAG source list, which was not read; off-image refusal for sections other than the five base shapes (nested lift, retraction or refusal terms as base members are outside the model); any cardinality claim about Carrier n or the declared table (node PG-SN-CARRIER); unrestricted old-image recovery (ledger row WDP-P001-019 stays a negative boundary for the unrestricted interface); the 36-glyph source alphabet beyond the generic statement, and alphabets above three glyphs in the native universes; wire parsing of the source grammar; decidability beyond this syntactic model (the source itself says the image condition is not a general computability theorem); the circular reading in which off-image is defined as failure of the round trip; any physical interpretation.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: For a restatement over an arbitrary glyph alphabet of the pinned S(n) section and retraction (five base shapes at a given stage), the retraction refuses exactly the presentations that are not section images at that stage, and the restated pair is a section/retraction pair (law and soundness) in the abstract sense, where refusal is the failure of the round trip s(r(p)) = p; this rests on the soundness of the specific retraction (accepted_only_from_section), because the old-image law alone is satisfied by a retraction that refuses nothing.
claim_boundary.next_test: With the bridge sn_is_section_retraction proved, extend the refusal characterisation to a grammar that admits nested lift, retraction and refusal terms as base members: add them to Base, restate sectionLift and retr on the enlarged type, and decide whether accepted_only_from_section and sectionLift injectivity still hold or whether a new off-image class appears.

Earlier-pass check: (a) amendments applied: narrowest_claim rewritten (restatement, five base shapes, soundness is what refuses, the law alone does not); supports says 'transcription of the pinned SnCarrier definitions ... restated, not imported'; the lax statement is scoped (Fin 1 -> Fin 2 abstract instance; laxRetr general; Bool instance at stage 0); the circular construction is disclosed; does_not_support lists the ledger interpretation, the unread prompt file, nested terms, cardinalities; independent_predicates scoped to 'glyph-word, arrow and pair bodies (not all presentations)' with the lax columns declared by-construction; the bridge theorem was proved rather than left open and next_test moved to nested terms; toy law_failures/sound_failures are now recomputed (retraction via divmod) instead of hard-coded; the missing mutants (payload_failures, accepted beyond the image, non-injective lift, zero-multiplier toy) were added; p4: 13 semantic and 354 coordinate mutants rejected, control accepted. earlier_pass.notes: Lean compiles (exit 0). Axioms confirmed: the S(n) re-proofs (old_image_base, accepted_only_from_section, accepted_iff, nonDescent_iff_off_image, retraction_stage_strict, inImage_iff, lax_breaks..., instance_refusals) report [propext] only, so 'All S(n) re-proofs report propext only' is true (keep it scoped: toy_refused_iff_odd reports propext+Quot.sound; the abstract Part-1 theorems are axiom-free or propext). Compile gives deprecation warnings (if_pos/if_neg) and an unused variable; cosmetic. I compared Part 2 with the pinned SnCarrier.lean (sectionLift, retractionDownMap, BasePresentation): the transcription is faithful (glyph lists [], [m], [f,s], arrow, pair; stage test; everything else nonDescent) apart from flattening one-field wrappers and treating GroundToken as unit. It is a manual transcription, not an import, so 'the pinned S(n) retraction' means 'a restatement of the pinned definitions'. Structural gap: Part 1 (SectionRetraction with law+sound) and Part 2 (the S(n) model) are never connected. There is no theorem that (sectionLift n, retr n) forms a SectionRetraction (retr returns Outcome, not Base + Unit), so 'which is the failure of s(r(p)) = p' in narrowest_claim is not a stated S(n) theorem; the S(n) results state 'p = sectionLift n b and q = b.toPres', which implies the round trip but is not stated as one. Also roundtrip_fails_off_image is close to a restatement: the round trip 'fails' off the image because r returns the refusal summand, which has no s-image; the content is refused_iff_off_image and its soundness hypothesis, which is a HYPOTHESIS of the structure. For S(n) soundness is proved (accepted_only_from_section), which is the real content, and the claim already says so. Lax: lax_retraction_obeys_law_but_accepts_off_image is an instance on Fin 1 -> Fin 2; lax_breaks_refusal_characterisation is an instance on Bool glyphs at stage 0; lax_obeys_law and lax_never_refuses are for every alphabet. Supports says 'instance and S(n) version' - fine but scope it. refuseOffImage_isSectionRetraction / toy_refused_iff_odd construct the retraction BY testing the round trip, i.e. the circular reading the boundary disclaims; fine as a construction result but must not be listed as support for the non-circular S(n) statement. Checker: independent representation (wire strings + regex parser, universe built separately), real recount of accepted/refused/payload/round trip/stage mismatch/long bodies. Weaknesses: (a) lax_iff_violations: lax_retract never returns None, so the checker's value is always the number of off-image points; lax_law_failures is forced 0 by construction; asserted constants dressed as counts. (b) toy law_failures/sound_failures are hard-coded 0 in expected_toy (not recomputed); on_image/refused come from y % c, independent of the round trip (good). (c) roundtrip_fails == refused is true by the checker's own definitions; the only content is accepted == rt_holds (soundness). (d) the universe contains only lift/retraction terms with glyph-word, arrow and pair bodies over the same letters, maxlen <= 4, alphabets <= 3 glyphs in the table, no nesting; chosen to be what the parser recognises. The Lean theorem is the real evidence for generality. Mutants: wrong_stage_lift_accepted, long_body_accepted, roundtrip_holds_everywhere, single_stage_universe_hides_stage_test, identity_section_has_off_image_points and the toy mutant are genuine; refusal_misses_a_off_image_point, old_image_law_implies_refusal, lax_retraction_breaks_the_law are single count flips. Missing near misses: (1) payload_failures > 0 (pair read as simplex, five shapes confused) although the payload clause of accepted_only_from_section is a headline claim; (2) accepted > image_size (a retraction term r_n<..> or NON_DESCENT accepted); (3) non-injective sectionLift (image_size < base count); sectionLift_injective is in Lean but not an anchor or table field; (4) toy section with c=0. Scope vs DAG: the DAG node is PROVED_LEAN against external SnOffImage.lean (36-glyph); this node re-proves for every alphabet from a transcription and adds soundness-necessity and the abstract part. It does not examine 'closing the domain-restriction half of WDP-P001-019' (ledger interpretation), and the external prompt file in source[0] was not read. Consistent with the status; add a scope caveat; do not raise. next_test: this node's own open obligation (nested terms as Base members), decidable and concrete, but literally the first item of does_not_support; better first: prove the S(n) SectionRetraction instance (the missing bridge).
